mapper.select: SELECT FROM stocktake_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,stocktake_id,batch_item_id,product_id,book_qty,actual_qty,difference_qty,reason_type,reason_note FROM stocktake_item WHERE stocktake_id=#{id} ORDER BY product_id,batch_item_id

SELECT CAST(s.id AS CHAR) id,CAST(s.product_id AS CHAR) product_id,b.product_code,b.product_name,b.unit,CAST(s.batch_item_id AS CHAR) batch_item_id,b.batch_no,b.production_date,b.expiry_date,s.book_qty,s.actual_qty,s.difference_qty,s.reason_type,s.reason_note FROM stocktake_item s JOIN purchase_item b ON b.id=s.batch_item_id WHERE s.stocktake_id=#{id} ORDER BY s.product_id,s.batch_item_id
mapper.sql: CAST(o.id AS CHAR) id,o.order_no,CAST(o.operator_id AS CHAR) operator_id,o.operator_name,o.status,o.started_at,o.submitted_at,o.completed_at,o.row_version,CAST(a.product_count AS SIGNED) product_count,CAST(a.batch_count AS SIGNED) batch_count,CAST(a.counted_count AS SIGNED) counted_count,CAST(a.book_qty AS SIGNED) book_qty,CAST(a.actual_qty AS SIGNED) actual_qty,CAST(a.difference_qty AS SIGNED) difference_qty

FROM stocktake_order o JOIN (SELECT stocktake_id,COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) product_count,COUNT(*) batch_count,COUNT(actual_qty) counted_count,SUM(book_qty) book_qty,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=COUNT(actual_qty) THEN SUM(actual_qty) ELSE NULL END actual_qty,CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=COUNT(actual_qty) THEN SUM(difference_qty) ELSE NULL END difference_qty FROM stocktake_item GROUP BY stocktake_id) a ON a.stocktake_id=o.id
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY o.started_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{q.pageSize} OFFSET #{q.offset}
